title: Design: Convert to No Charge is greyed out on a work order with a deposit
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new billable work order for the regular customer with a deposit, made for this test.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow2-02-1b-convert-to-no-charge-deposit.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Click the three-dots menu in the header.
  3. Hover Convert to No Charge.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • "Convert to No Charge" is greyed out (disabled).

Step 3:

  • The tooltip reads "Reverse the deposit first".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-N4: “If the work order has a deposit, "Convert to No Charge" is disabled with the tooltip "Reverse the deposit first", as the Change Customer button on the customer card is today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
